title: crepis vesicaria subsp. erythia
intro: Crepis vesicaria subsp. erythia, commonly known as hawkweed or red hawk's beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis vesicaria subsp. erythia include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and treating respiratory problems such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
